Banana Bread

Makes 8 servings. Prep time: 15 minutes. Cook time: 1 hour 5 minutes.

Ingredients

  • 3 ripe bananas
  • 1/3 cup melted butter
  • 3/4 cup sugar
  • 1 egg, beaten
  • 1 1/2 cups flour

Instructions

Preheat the oven to 175 °C and grease a loaf pan.

Mash the bananas, stir in butter, sugar and egg, then fold in the flour.

Bake for about 60 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.

Notes

Keeps for three days in a tin.
